plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1950s President Eisenhower had a Psychological Strategy Board, a group that ran the military's psychological operations, meaning efforts to shape what people believe. According to Michels, its circle included Gordon Gray, Charles Douglas Jackson and a man named Philip Corso, and much of the early lore about aliens came from those same people, which would suggest the stories were shaped by people whose job was influencing public belief.
